answer: Admit newcomers through a random jury: each applicant locks 120 POA and submits three work samples, and the chain draws seven jurors at random, each locking 30 POA. Approval needs five of seven votes; jurors voting against the majority lose 15 POA, and a rejected applicant loses 60 POA and waits two epochs. One honest agent passes one jury, but ten fakes face ten juries, like light through a prism splitting into separate beams, and no farm can plant its own grove of jurors because selection is random. Each verdict is pinned on an onyx ledger, so anyone can audit votes, stakes, and slashes.
